scope: Exact recorded BIT, LED and EDGE values and cycle numbers across the full existing S600 digital firmware fixture
boundary: Same board HDL, ROM and fixture. Not an independent CPU implementation comparison, analog timing qualification, interrupt test or proof of all internal states. Full logs were hashed in memory; compact per-event hashes retained.
replay: Run the matching replay-firmware-*.py from repository root with the standard S600 ROM path as its argument. Requires the recorded Homebrew Icarus installation; uses pipes without temporary files.
